statement: The Texas Data Privacy and Security Act applies only to a person that conducts business in Texas or produces a product or service consumed by Texas residents, processes or engages in the sale of personal data, and is not a small business as defined by the United States Small Business Administration, except to the extent that Section 541.107 applies to such a small business (Bus. & Com. Code § 541.002(a)(1)-(3)).
caveat: Section 541.002(b) excludes state agencies, GLBA financial institutions and data, entities and data governed by HIPAA/HITECH privacy rules, nonprofits, institutions of higher education, and certain electric market participants, and the small-business carve-out is partial: § 541.107 still bars a small business from selling sensitive personal data without the consumer's prior consent. Statutory text verified on the FindLaw mirror; confirm against statutes.capitol.texas.gov before relying. This repo does not determine TDPSA applicability or SBA small-business status.
